task: put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the wine bottle standing on the table.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper around its neck.
Grasp the wine bottle by closing the gripper around its neck while it stands on the table.
Grasp the wine bottle by its neck and lift it vertically off the table.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, lifting it above the metal bowl.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, moving it toward the cabinet.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, moving it toward the cabinet.
Hold the wine bottle above the cabinet, aligning it for placement.
Lower the wine bottle down onto the top surface of the cabinet.
Lower the wine bottle down onto the top surface of the dark cabinet.
Carry the wine bottle horizontally over the top of the cabinet.
Release the wine bottle onto the top surface of the dark cabinet.
